timestamp.description: ISO 8601 date-time with an explicit UTC offset, used for auditable repository timestamps.

date.description: ISO 8601 full calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD form.

source_id.description: Human-readable immutable Source Document identifier following docs/SOURCE_REFERENCE.md.

source_ids.description: Non-empty deduplicated Source Document IDs providing provenance for a record.

confidence_score.description: Evidence confidence from 1 (unverified/speculative) through 5 (verified SEC filing).

status.description: Lifecycle state of the represented entity or repository record; unknown means evidence is insufficient.

notes.description: Optional factual or methodological clarification; null means none is recorded.

currency.description: ISO 4217 three-letter uppercase currency code for an adjacent monetary value.

percentage.description: Decimal fraction from 0 through 1, where 0.25 represents 25 percent.

uuid.description: Canonical RFC 4122 UUID string used as an immutable entity or relationship identifier.
